name: mediafetch-web
description: MediaFetch Web - Descargador responsivo de Video MP4 y Música MP3

scripts.postinstall: python3 -m pip install --upgrade --break-system-packages yt-dlp || pip3 install --upgrade --break-system-packages yt-dlp || python -m pip install --upgrade yt-dlp || (mkdir -p bin && curl -L https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/releases/latest/download/yt-dlp -o bin/yt-dlp && chmod +x bin/yt-dlp) || true

author: Zuriel Montaño
